name: Libraries.dev
summary: Seven React UI effect libraries (Beam, Orb, Avatars, Gooey, Metal, Image, Voice) installed from npm or a coding-agent prompt.
description: Production-ready React effect libraries for modern apps: an animated border beam, thought-orb loaders for AI interfaces, liquid metal, gooey morphing, animated bot avatars, an image-generation loader and a sound-reactive voice glow. The free packages are MIT and install from npm (border-beam, thinking-orbs, liquid-gooey, metal-fx, img-fx …); every library also ships as a prompt your coding agent builds. Pro ($9/mo) adds the Studio, presets and an agent skill.
